Checking each shape's position within its band, I find they're all being recentered - each 2x2 shape shifts to sit in the middle columns/rows of its 4-wide cell rather than its original offset position. So the rule is: center every 2x2 shape within its bounded cell. Now I'll apply this centering logic to the test input.
I'm mapping out the marker positions and band centers, then tracking how each shape block shifts from its original rows/cols to the centered position within its band.
